Wii Party (native) - controls
=============================

One player per PC: the keyboard, the mouse and one gamepad (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch)
all play player 1. For more players on this PC, pick 2-4 in the launcher (Settings >
Players on this PC); gamepads are then players 2, 3 and 4. A gamepad joins when you
press a button on it. Online, friends are players 2-4.

Player 1: keyboard and mouse (every key can be changed in the launcher)
  Pointer                  Mouse (or the arrow keys once the mouse has been still for 3 seconds)
  A / B                    Left click, Enter or Space / Right click or Backspace
  1 / 2                    1 / 2
  + / - / HOME             = (Plus) / Minus / H
  D-pad                    Arrow keys, W A S D
  Shake                    Middle click or Left Shift
  Swing up / down          Mouse wheel, T / G
  Tilt forward / back      R / F
  Turn left / right        Q / E
  Upright or sideways grip F1

Gamepad
  A / Cross = A, B / Circle = B, X = 1, Y = 2, Start = +, Back = -, Guide = HOME,
  D-pad = D-pad, right stick = pointer, left stick = tilt, left shoulder = shake,
  right shoulder = B.

F11  Full screen on/off. The title bar shows the frame rate and the grip.

Launcher: double-click "Wii Party.bat" to pick the disc folder, upscale, screen shape,
full screen and player 1 keys, then press Play. Settings are kept in settings.ini.
